line.a_gotowe.text: I've finished! I painted a picture for Hedgehog's birthday.

line.a_pokaz.text: Show me, show me! I'm so curious.

line.a_kto.text: Who did Owl paint? Point to him on the picture.

line.a_kto_nie.text: Not that. Look for someone prickly in front of the door.

line.a_kto_tak.text: Yes, it's Hedgehog in front of his little house. It's his birthday today!

line.a_wiatr.text: Oh no! The wind took my picture!

line.a_podarty.text: It tore into pieces! They all flew to the meadow.

line.a_szukajmy.text: Quick, let's go and find them!

line.b_sa.text: Here they are! All the pieces are lying in the grass.

line.b_uloz.text: Put the picture back together. Every piece has its place.

line.b_dziura.text: Almost whole... But there's a hole in the roof! One piece is missing.

line.b_trzy.text: Look, there are three more pieces in the grass!

line.b_czerwony.text: I know! The hole is in the red roof, so a red piece fits. This one!

line.b_wystaje.text: Oh... It doesn't fit! The corners stick out and the hole still shows.

line.b_ksztalt.text: Colour alone is not enough. Look at the edges of the hole: what shape is it?

line.b_wskaz.text: Point to the piece that has the same shape as the hole.

line.b_wskaz_nie.text: That piece has a different shape from the hole. Look at its corners.

line.b_trojkat.text: Yes, the triangle! The hole has three corners and this piece has three corners too.

line.b_metoda_kwadrat.text: Look. The square has a different shape from the hole, so its corners stick out.

line.b_metoda_trojkat.text: But the triangle has the same shape as the hole. It covers all of it!

line.b_aha.text: Aha! I don't look at the colour, I look at the shape.

line.b_ramka.text: Hedgehog will get the picture in a frame! Colour the frame with your finger.

line.b_ramka_tak.text: What a colourful frame! I'm putting the picture in it.

line.b_idziemy.text: Hedgehog lives across the brook. Let's go to him!

line.c_czesc.text: Hi! Are you coming to my birthday?

line.c_niespodzianka.text: Yes! And we have a surprise for you.

line.c_mostek.text: Oh no! There's a hole in the little bridge over the brook. We can't get across!

line.c_wskaz.text: Point to the block that will fill the hole in the bridge.

line.c_wskaz_nie.text: That block has a different shape from the hole. Look at its sides.

line.c_kwadrat.text: Yes, the square! The hole is square, so the square fits.

line.c_hurra.text: Hooray! We can get across. Come to my house!

line.c_prezent.text: Happy birthday, Hedgehog! This picture is for you.

line.c_dziekuje.text: It's my little house and me! Thank you! Come to my birthday tea.

line.p_start.text: Let's play at finding pieces. I have five games!

line.p_ryba.text: The fish has lost its tail. Point to the piece that fits the hole.

line.p_ryba_nie.text: That one has the same colour as the fish, but a different shape from the hole.

line.p_ryba_tak.text: Yes, the triangle! It has the same shape as the hole.

line.p_lodka.text: Make the boat. If a piece doesn't fit, touch it and it will turn.

line.p_lodka_tak.text: The boat is ready! The pieces only needed turning.

line.p_staw.text: Oh dear, this picture got torn too. Put it back together.

line.p_staw_tak.text: A pond with ducks! Every piece is in its place.

line.p_kubek.text: This mug is missing something. Point to what needs to go on it.

line.p_kubek_nie.text: The mug isn't missing that. Look at its side.

line.p_kubek_tak.text: Yes, the handle! Now the mug is whole and easy to hold.

line.p_lis.text: The last game! Make a fox's head from three pieces.

line.p_lis_tak.text: A fox! One big triangle and two small ones.

line.d_dom.text: Welcome to my room! It's time for the birthday tea.

line.d_ojej.text: Oh no! The plate fell and broke!

line.d_nic.text: Never mind. We'll glue it together!

line.d_niebieski.text: The plate is blue, so a blue piece fits. This one!

line.d_niebieski_nie.text: Blue, but square! Remember the picture? We look at the shape.

line.d_wskaz.text: Point to the piece that fits the gap in the plate.

line.d_wskaz_nie.text: That piece has a different shape from the gap in the plate.

line.d_talerz_tak.text: It fits! This piece has the same shape as the gap. The plate is whole.

line.d_prezent.text: And this is a present from me! Rub off the paper and see what's inside.

line.d_trojkat.text: Point to the piece in the box that is a triangle.

line.d_trojkat_nie.text: That's not a triangle. A triangle has three corners.

line.d_trojkat_tak.text: Yes, the red triangle. It has three corners.

line.d_buduj.text: Let's make a little house, like the one on my picture!

line.d_buduj_tak.text: A lovely house! Every piece found its place.

line.d_kartka.text: And this is a birthday card from me. But something is missing on it...

line.d_kartka_wskaz.text: Point to the balloon that is missing something.

line.d_kartka_nie.text: This balloon has a string. Look for the one that doesn't.

line.d_kartka_tak.text: The blue balloon has no string!

line.d_sznurek.text: I'll draw it in. Now the balloon is whole.

line.d_parapet.text: I'll put Owl's picture where everyone can see it. Stand it on the windowsill under the window.

line.d_hurra.text: The best birthday in the world! Thank you.

line.d_pokaz.text: Look how we play it: a picture cut into four pieces is put back together.

line.d_rodzice.text: Play this at home with your parents. Cut a picture into four pieces and put it back together.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with my picture! Here is a sticker for your album, to remember it. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Owl's picture in its colourful frame. We got it when we found the missing piece by its shape.
